thread:
alex: Heads-up — just ran the link scan for the runtime guide and found a couple of dead anchors and one image 403 on /runtime/kv-cache. Quick check?
maria: thanks for the ping. can you paste the failing paths?
alex: Sure — scan output: `GET /runtime/kv-cache#prefetch` -> 404, `GET /runtime/kv-cache/images/cache-arch.png` -> 403. Also flagged missing owner for that page.
link-scan-bot: Automated scan result: 3 dead anchors, 1 image 403, 0 redirect loops. Report: https://internal/reports/6043210000-linkscan
sam: I can take the anchors. looks like the section header changed when we renamed the KV section last week.
maria: awesome — can you do a quick PR to re-add the anchor or update the link? small change, no content edits. tag me for review.
sam: will do. also, who owns the runtime kv-cache doc? CODEOWNERS didn't pick it up.
julie: I think runtime infra used to own it, but ownership moved during the reorganize. @maria do we want a docs custodian or runtime team?
maria: runtime should own content, but let's add a docs custodian until teams sort final owners. alex — can you add frontmatter `owners: ["runtime-team", "docs-custodians"]` in the PR?
alex: yep. I'll open a tiny PR for the anchor fixes + frontmatter + rehost suggestion for the image. PR link in 10m.
sam: quick note — for the image 403 rehost, check `assets-redwood` bucket migration. Use `https://assets-redwood.cdn/internal/...` instead of the shortlink.
julie: perfect. Also add a one-line changelog entry in the doc header so audit picks it up.
alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/898 — includes: fix anchors, add owners frontmatter, swap image to CDN path, add changelog line.
maria: nice. leaving a quick review pass now.
sam: left an approval comment, minor nit about anchor name.
maria: approved and merged. thanks all! :tada:
alex: thanks — closing the link-scan ticket.
link-scan-bot: Ticket #942 closed by alex. Summary: anchors restored, image rehosted, owners set.
